{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Sauces|Sauces]]

'''Wow-Wow Sauce''' is a sauce, apparently created by Dr. William Kitchiner in the early 19th century. It contains port, wine vinegar, pickled cucumbers or Pickled Walnuts, English mustard and mushroom ketchup in a base of beef stock, flour and butter.

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Vinegar|vinegar]]
* 1 tbsp mushroom ketchup and/or [[Cookbook:Port Wine|port wine]]
* 1 tbsp prepared [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]]
* [[Cookbook:Parsley|Parsley]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2–3 pickled [[Cookbook:Cucumber|cucumbers]] or [[Cookbook:Walnut|walnuts]], chopped

== Procedure ==
# Put a piece of butter as big as an egg into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. When it is melted, stir in the flour and beef broth.
# Add vinegar, mushroom ketchup, and mustard. [[Cookbook:Simmering|Simmer]] together until it is as thick as you wish.
# Add the parsley and pickles, and warm them through.

[[Category:Recipes for sauces and condiments|{{PAGENAME}}]]
